class.name: InputRouter
class.brief_description: A singleton that owns the input device each frame and routes gamepad input through a path of contexts.

method.name: attach
method.description: Places [param binding] in [param context], or in the binding's own [member RouteBindingResource.context] if [param context] is empty, and returns a handle for [method detach]. [param target] is called as [code]target.call(phase, value)[/code] each time the binding fires. Handles are never [code]0[/code] and never reused; returns [code]0[/code] if the binding has no id or no context. A binding the route map lacks is compiled into a new map and placed at the next frame, with a warning to rebake. From another thread, the handle is reserved at once and the attach runs on the main thread.

method.name: axis_input
method.description: Returns the input slot of [param axis]: its negative half for a negative [param direction], the full axis for [code]0[/code], its positive half for a positive one. Returns [code]-1[/code] for an invalid axis. Use the slot with [method set_override], [method get_input_label] and [method get_input_glyph].

method.name: button_input
method.description: Returns the input slot of [param button], or [code]-1[/code] for a button the router does not track. Button slots are [code]0[/code] to [code]20[/code], the [enum JoyButton] values.

method.name: check_maps
method.description: Checks gamepad data against the router's routing rules without running it. [param placements] holds [RouteBindingResource]s or [code]{context, binding, source}[/code] dictionaries for bindings attached from code. [param paths] lists context paths the game uses, outer to inner. Returns one dictionary per finding: [code]{rule, severity, context, a, b, message}[/code], where [code]rule[/code] is one of [code]missing_id[/code], [code]compile_error[/code], [code]duplicate_id[/code], [code]unknown_context[/code], [code]clash[/code], [code]gate_bound_alone[/code], [code]shadowed[/code] or [code]cap[/code], and [code]a[/code] and [code]b[/code] are the binding ids involved. [b]Note:[/b] Only available in editor builds.

method.name: clear
method.description: Detaches every binding, clears every named callback and pops every pushed context. Base contexts stay.

method.name: clear_callback
method.description: Removes a named callback added with [method set_callback]. Unknown handles are ignored.

method.name: clear_override
method.description: Restores the authored input and gate of every binding with id [param binding_id].

method.name: clear_overrides
method.description: Restores every binding's authored input and gate.

method.name: detach
method.description: Removes the binding placed by [method attach]. A press it holds is canceled: its callback receives [constant PHASE_CANCELED] and its action is released. Unknown handles are ignored.

method.name: get_active_pad
method.description: Returns the device id of the pad that owns gamepad input, or [code]-1[/code] if none has yet. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_chord_window
method.description: Returns how long, in seconds, an input pressed just before its chord's gate still completes the chord. See [method set_chord_window].

method.name: get_connected_pads
method.description: Returns the device ids of connected pads, lowest first. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_device
method.description: Returns the device that owns input this frame. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_device_policy
method.description: Returns the current device policy. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the number of frames the router has routed, the newest sealed one included. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_gamepad_context
method.description: Returns the innermost context of the path, or an empty [StringName] if the path is empty.

method.name: get_gamepad_context_path
method.description: Returns the context path, outer to inner: base contexts, then pushed ones.

method.name: get_input_glyph
method.description: Returns the prompt texture for input slot [param input] in [param family]'s style, from the [GamepadGlyphProvider] at [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/router/glyph_provider]. Returns [code]null[/code] if no provider is set or it has no glyph.

method.name: get_input_label
method.description: Returns the name [param family] gives input slot [param input]. Labels are positional: the bottom face button is [code]"A"[/code] on Xbox, [code]"Cross"[/code] on PlayStation and [code]"B"[/code] on Nintendo.

method.name: get_mouse_in_pad
method.description: Returns what happens to mouse motion while a pad owns the frame.

method.name: get_overrides
method.description: Returns the player's rebinds as [code]{binding_id: [input, gate]}[/code], with [code]gate[/code] [code]-1[/code] for none. Save it and replay each entry through [method set_override] to restore them.

method.name: get_pad_axis
method.description: Returns the raw value of [param axis] on [param pad] this frame, or on the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. Pad state is captured whichever device owns the frame. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_pad_family
method.description: Returns the family of [param pad], or of the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. The family comes from the Steam hardware ids, then the SDL controller type, which names the physical pad even behind Steam Input, then the pad's name. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_pad_info
method.description: Returns [code]{device, name, guid, sdl_type, vendor_id, product_id, steam_input, family}[/code] for connected [param pad], or the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary if that pad is not connected.

method.name: get_pad_name
method.description: Returns the name of connected [param pad], or of the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. Empty if that pad is not connected.

method.name: get_pad_stick
method.description: Returns [param stick] on [param pad], or on the active pad for [code]-1[/code], with a radial [param deadzone]: zero inside it, rescaled to start from zero past it, direction kept. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_pointer_velocity
method.description: Returns the virtual pointer's velocity this frame, in pixels per second. Thread-safe.

method.name: get_routes
method.description: Returns what each physical input reaches on the current path: per input its gated bindings, inner context first, then the ungated binding that wins it, then the sequences being watched. Each entry is [code]{input, label, gate, gate_input, binding_label, context, id, action, trigger, handle, fallback}[/code]: [code]label[/code] and [code]gate[/code] are the input and gate names in the active pad's family, [code]gate_input[/code] is the gate's button slot ([code]-1[/code] for none), [code]binding_label[/code] is [member RouteBindingResource.label], and [code]fallback[/code] is the input's [enum GamepadContext.Fallback] on this path ([code]-1[/code] for a sequence). For debug overlays and prompts.

method.name: get_scheme
method.description: Returns the selected control scheme, or an empty [StringName] for none.

method.name: get_schemes
method.description: Returns every scheme named by the route map or by an attached binding.

method.name: get_sequence_timeout
method.description: Returns the seconds allowed between the steps of a [constant RouteBindingResource.TRIGGER_SEQUENCE] binding.

method.name: get_touch_mode
method.description: Returns how touch input is treated.

method.name: get_trace
method.description: Returns the trace records since the last call, oldest first, and empties the trace. Each record is [code]{usec, frame, path, context, id, pad, input, label, phase, outcome, value}[/code]. [code]outcome[/code] is one of [code]"routed"[/code], [code]"passed"[/code], [code]"swallowed"[/code], [code]"suppressed"[/code], [code]"dropped_switch"[/code], [code]"sequence_abandoned"[/code], [code]"switch"[/code] or [code]"canceled"[/code]. [code]path[/code] is the context path at the time, while it is still among the last 32 paths. See [method set_trace_enabled].

method.name: get_trigger_wake_threshold
method.description: Returns how far a trigger must be pulled to wake the pad.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the router filtered the newest sealed frame. Thread-safe.

method.name: is_gamepad_context_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param context] is in the path and pad input can reach it: no [member GamepadContext.modal] context sits above it.

method.name: is_pad_button_down
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param button] is held on [param pad] this frame, or on the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. Pad state is captured whichever device owns the frame and whatever the button is bound to. Thread-safe.

method.name: is_switch_frame
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the device changed this frame. That frame's input was dropped. Thread-safe.

method.name: is_trace_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the router is recording a trace.

method.name: load_map
method.description: Attaches every binding of [param map] under one handle and returns it for [method unload_map]. Each binding goes into its own context, else the map's. The map's context is registered first.

method.name: pop_gamepad_context
method.description: Removes the context pushed with [param handle], wherever it is in the path; the rest keep their order. Claims held by bindings that are no longer reachable are canceled. Unknown handles are ignored.

method.name: push_gamepad_context
method.description: Pushes [param context] on top of the path and returns a handle for [method pop_gamepad_context]. Claims held by bindings that are no longer reachable are canceled. The path holds 16 contexts.

method.name: register_gamepad_context
method.description: Adds [param context], or updates the context with the same id. A change to the fallback or modal flag of a context in the path takes effect at the next frame.

method.name: set_callback
method.description: Calls [param target] for bindings with id [param binding_id] in [param context], including bindings loaded by [method load_map] without a target, and those placed later. Called as [code]target.call(phase, value)[/code], after the binding's own target. Returns a handle for [method clear_callback]. One named callback per [param context] and [param binding_id]: if several are set, the first one set is called and the others wait until it is cleared. Clearing one from inside a callback is safe; callbacks still queued that frame skip it.

method.name: set_chord_window
method.description: Sets how long an input pressed just before its chord's gate is held back to complete the chord. Clamped to [code]0[/code]–[code]0.12[/code] s; default [code]0.05[/code] s.

method.name: set_device
method.description: Hands the frame to [param device], and to [param pad] for [constant DEVICE_PAD], the way a wake would: claims cancel, input the old device passed is released, and every pad input held off rest is engaged until it returns to rest.

method.name: set_device_policy
method.description: Sets which devices may own the frame. If the device in charge is no longer allowed, it hands over at once.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Installs or removes the router as [Input]'s frame filter. Takes effect at the next frame, like every mutator: [method is_enabled] changes after it. Disabling releases every action and passed input the router holds; the frame's queued callbacks and signals are dropped. Fails in the editor, and if another frame filter is installed.

method.name: set_gamepad_base_contexts
method.description: Replaces the base of the path, outer to inner, to mirror the game's own state stack. Pushed contexts stay above them.

method.name: set_mouse_in_pad
method.description: Sets what happens to mouse motion while a pad owns the frame.

method.name: set_override
method.description: Rebinds every binding with id [param binding_id], now and when placed later, to input slot [param input] with button slot [param gate], or no gate for [code]-1[/code]. A stick binding only takes a stick and the reverse. Returns [code]false[/code] if the slots are invalid or the kinds differ. Persist the result of [method get_overrides].

method.name: set_route_map
method.description: Replaces the route map. The map is checked now and refused with an error if it does not match this build. The next frame releases every claim and rebuilds every row from the new templates, keeping placements, contexts and the scheme; a placement the new map lacks is dropped with an error. Before anything is placed, the map applies at once.

method.name: set_scheme
method.description: Selects the control scheme. Bindings with an empty [member RouteBindingResource.scheme] always apply; others only under their scheme. Cancels every claim. An empty [param scheme] selects none.

method.name: set_sequence_timeout
method.description: Sets the seconds allowed between the steps of a sequence. Clamped to [code]0.3[/code]–[code]2.0[/code] s; default [code]0.8[/code] s.

method.name: set_touch_mode
method.description: Sets how touch input is treated. Touches live under the old mode end first: passed ones release, routed ones cancel.

method.name: set_trace_enabled
method.description: Starts or stops recording what happens to each input: routed, passed, swallowed, suppressed, dropped by a device switch. The trace is a ring of [param capacity] records, [code]64[/code] to [code]65536[/code]; the oldest are overwritten. Read it with [method get_trace].

method.name: set_trigger_wake_threshold
method.description: Sets how far a trigger must be pulled to wake the pad, [code]0.05[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Default [code]0.5[/code].

method.name: stick_input
method.description: Returns the input slot of [param stick], or [code]-1[/code] for an invalid stick.

method.name: take_pointer_delta
method.description: Returns the virtual pointer's movement in pixels since the last call, and resets it. Pointer bindings ([member RouteBindingResource.pointer]) feed it, and so does mouse motion in pad frames with [constant MOUSE_IN_PAD_POINTER].

method.name: unload_map
method.description: Detaches every binding [method load_map] placed under [param handle].

method.name: was_pad_button_pressed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param button] went down on [param pad] this frame, or on the active pad for [code]-1[/code]. Thread-safe.

signal.name: active_pad_lost
signal.description: Emitted when the active pad disconnects, after [signal pad_disconnected]. Its claims were canceled and [method get_active_pad] is [code]-1[/code]. The device stays [constant DEVICE_PAD] until another device wakes.

signal.name: device_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the device or the active pad changes. [param device] and [param previous_device] are [enum Device] values.

signal.name: gamepad_context_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the context path changes, at most once per frame. [param path] is outer to inner.

signal.name: pad_connected
signal.description: Emitted when a pad connects while the router is enabled. Pads already connected when it is enabled do not emit it.

signal.name: routes_changed
signal.description: Emitted when what an input reaches may have changed: a binding was placed or removed, or the path or scheme changed. At most once per frame. Refresh prompts from [method get_routes].

signal.name: scheme_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_scheme] selects another scheme.

signal.name: touch_routed
signal.description: Emitted for each touch event in pad frames with [constant TOUCH_AS_PAD], in place of passing it to Godot. [param phase] is [constant PHASE_PRESSED], [constant PHASE_CHANGED] for a drag, [constant PHASE_RELEASED] or [constant PHASE_CANCELED].

constants.constant: Number of input slots: 21 buttons, then three per axis (negative half, full, positive half) for six axes, then the two sticks.
No device has woken since the router was enabled.
Keyboard and mouse own the frame. Pad input is captured but not routed.
A gamepad owns the frame, [method get_active_pad]. Keyboard and mouse input is dropped.
Whichever device wakes takes the frame.
Only a gamepad may own the frame. Keyboard and mouse never wake.
Only keyboard and mouse may own the frame. Pads never wake.
Mouse motion in pad frames is dropped.
Mouse motion in pad frames moves the virtual pointer ([method take_pointer_delta]) without waking keyboard and mouse.
Touch belongs to keyboard and mouse: a touch wakes them and passes to Godot, which can emulate the mouse from it.
Touch belongs to the pad, as on a pad's touchpad or a handheld's screen: a touch wakes the active or first connected pad, and touches in pad frames become [signal touch_routed].
Touch neither wakes a device nor reaches Godot; the router drops it.
An unrecognized pad. Labels follow Xbox names.
An Xbox pad.
A PlayStation pad.
A Nintendo pad or Joy-Con.
A Steam Deck or Steam Controller.
Number of families.
The input was pressed, a repeat binding started, or a sequence completed.
The input was released.
The binding lost its claim without a release: a device switch, a path or scheme change, a detach, or a disconnect. Undo whatever the press started.
A hold binding's input stayed down for its hold time.
A tap binding's input was released within its tap time.
A repeat binding's input is still held.
An analog binding's value changed.
